[SWS_CM_80502] Mapping of Find Service (
Signal-Based Static
network
binding)
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00004
⌈
When instructed to
find
a service instance which is mapped to a
RequiredUserDe-
finedServiceInstance
of
category SIGNALBASED_WITH_HEADER
or
SIGNAL-
BASED_NO_HEADER
, then the
Signal-Based Static
network binding shall imme-
diately return a
ara::com::ServiceHandleContainer
with information about the
static connection:
•
localUdpPortNumber
or
localTcpPortNumber
• information about the
EthernetCommunicationConnector
(VLAN) where
the connection shall be applied to
• a
multicastIpAddress
where the events will be consumed in case of multicast
reception
•
remotePeer
information of the remote sender of the data (IP-Address and Port
number)
⌋
